$comment: Known docks and hubs. IDs are lower-case hex vid:pid. 'hubs' lists every logical hub the dock exposes so its internal chain counts as one hop. 'port_map' pins logical hub ports to printed labels; only entries verified on real hardware belong here. Community-contributable.

generic_internal_hubs.8087:0b40: Intel Goshen Ridge USB hub, present inside most Thunderbolt 4 docks

ports.label: Thunderbolt 4
ports.notes: Lightning-bolt icon. USB4 devices tunnel PCIe here and leave the USB tree; a USB4 SSD shows up as an NVMe disk.

ports.label: USB-C Data
ports.notes: Same connector shape as the Thunderbolt ports but 10 Gbps. Label confirmed on hardware 2026-09-07.
